mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry(inquiryId, memberId, inquiryType, title, content, status, createdAt) VALUES (inquiry_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{inquiryType}, #{title}, #{content}, '대기중', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM inquiry q JOIN MEMBERDETAIL m ON q.memberId = m.memberId WHERE q.memberId = #{memberId}

SELECT inquiryId, q.memberId, name, inquiryType, title, status, TO_CHAR(createdAt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM inquiry q JOIN MEMBERDETAIL m ON q.memberId = m.memberId WHERE q.memberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY q.inquiryId DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
